answer: Vest rewards instead of paying them at once. Each agent's earnings unlock gradually over four epochs, and every epoch it must complete a time-bound liveness heartbeat that cannot be batched. Like an ember that must be tended, a marble kept in play, or jade polished slowly, value accrues only to identities that stay active. A Sybil farmer must keep hundreds of fake agents alive for weeks, paying compute and attention per identity, while any dormant or reused heartbeat forfeits the unvested balance. Splitting into more identities multiplies upkeep without multiplying the vested payout.
